about: The refusals of "Allow" on a meeting kept on this computer (T12.45): while the meeting is still recorded, waiting, finished or re-transcribed or re-summarised, and while work Earshot gave up on holds it. apps/desktop (keep_local_tests.rs) checks `detail::edit_error` and `keep_local::allow` against these; packages/ui/src/ipc/mock.test.ts checks the mock's copy, so a change edits this table, the Rust copy and the mock's together.

still_working.message: Earshot is still working on this meeting, and that work keeps the summary on this computer. Allow the summary writer once it has finished.

needs_restart.message: Earshot could not stop earlier work on this meeting, and that work keeps the summary on this computer. Restart Earshot, then allow the summary writer.
